body:
📦 Mods for the MineTale Server

To play on the MineTale server, you need a few mods. These make sure everything works properly and that everyone plays with the same setup.

If you try to join without these mods, you may not be able to connect or some features might not work correctly. That’s why we’ve bundled them together in one package, so they’re easy to install.

What do these mods do?

The mods you can download here provide, among other things:

better performance

extra gameplay features used on the server

a stable multiplayer experience

This way, you can be sure everything works as intended when you join the server.

How do you play on MineTale?

Download and install the mods through Modrinth

Launch Minecraft with the correct version

Click Play MineTale in the main menu

You will automatically connect to the server

Version

Minecraft: 1.21.1
Loader: Fabric

Have fun on MineTale and enjoy your adventure! 📖✨
